info.title: GATEWAY-batchinsertion-List Petadoption Pets Fosters-v1-spec
info.description: The Pet Adoption Foster Listing API provides access to a comprehensive list of pets available for fostering under the adoption program. This resource allows potential fosters to view detailed information about each animal, enhancing their ability to make informed choices when considering a foster pet. Typical consumers include animal rescue organizations and individuals interested in fostering pets. The API offers a means to support animal welfare efforts by facilitating connections between fosters and pets in need.

get.description: This endpoint allows users to retrieve a list of pets that are available for fostering. It provides essential information about each pet, enabling potential foster caregivers to find suitable companions.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to specify the parameters needed to foster a pet. It should contain the necessary details for the animal being fostered.

200.description: Successfully retrieved the list of available pets for fostering.
